items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: it had Jack Gilford, Carl Reiner, and David Burns. They were three of the principals.

ctx.x: When we stopped off yesterday, we were in the early ’50s and you were going to the Manhattan School. When you were in school, you were also doing a lot of Broadway plays, weren’t you? You started at . . . .

For the most part – I did most of it during the time I was in the Diamond Horseshoe. Then I went into the theaters, and I was doing – I did a show called Alive and Kicking, which was the – that was the first show I ever did. That was a show – it had Jack Gilford, Carl Reiner, and David Burns. They were three of the principals. There were some others. I forget – I’m sorry I can’t remember the lady’s name, who was in the play. It was more of a revue. It wasn’t a typical Broadway show. It was called Alive and…
This was the one that Noble Sissle allowed you to go . . . .
